Results.ReviewText:
I own multiple Pellet and Charcoal grills from high smokers to a Weber Kettle. When winter arrives it can become unpleasant to BBQ when you have several feet of snow, 0 degree temperatures, high winds and usually a rain or snow storm brewing or ongoing. I needed something to fill the gap during those times. After some research I chose the Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill.
The Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill turns out to be the little BBQ grill that can get the job done. I am pleased with it's construction, performance and grilling results. 
If you are looking for a smaller BBQ grill I recommend you check this one out'
Results.Title: The little BBQ grill that could

Results.ReviewText:
I like my new Weber. This is my third Weber gas grill. I purchased this model because I wanted to be able to mount the propane tank on the outside of the grill. My previous Webers required mounting the tank inside the cabinet. I found this to be very cumbersome.with a full tank. Too heavy and poor leverage. The new Weber is simple to use and provides good grill space. I think the grease management system will be easier to clean.
One problem I have encountered is one of the plastic wheel hub covers keeps falling off. It does not snap securely in place. Not sure what causes this problem. The grill was assembled by retail sales store. So I have to explore a solution.
Results.Title: My new Weber II E-310 Gas Grill

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
